quest.title: The Nithron's Cipher
quest.description: A little-known tome that contains the secrets of locating a device to decipher Nithron runes!

node.journal_entry: Within these pages I shall divulge my ingenious peoplemethodology and research into the theories behind much of what we know of the Ancient Nithron and their sudden disappearance so long ago.

node.journal_entry: Soon..so would all the ancient secrets of the Nithron...provided the Agonian could find some.

node.journal_entry: The Second in a series of amazing books written by myself, Garlish the Ever Inventive that in no way seeks to extort the reader of their moneys. Within these pages you will find the secrets of locating the Nithron Cipher! An item of untold usefulness and well worth reading and, more importantly, buying, my books!

It is common knowledge that the so called Elvish civilizations (Mirdain, Ithwen, Ciel Fey, and Arthain) took their first tentative steps into the world when their benevolent masters, the Nithron, inexplicably ceased to be. Their former halls empty and silent, the Nithron had seemingly abandoned their slave race and left the elves to step blinking into the light of freedom.
Lesser known is the fact that much of these secrets and information can be gleaned from a secretive form of runespeak the Nithron left behind in many of their ruins around Agon.
I suppose one could, if so inclined, the refer to this as ruinspeak! Do you see what I did there?

At the height of the Alfari nations power, certain pseudo-mystical devices were created by inquiring minds (I use the term "mind" quite loosely here) with the purpose of deciphering this hidden language. Should you, dear and gullible reader, have any interest in the above, you have simply to acquire my book entitled: Alfari Devices and you will be well on your way to the secrets of the universe! (Or, more likely than not, ancient Nithron grocery lists...)
The Cipher, as with all Alfari devices, requires activation using 5 numbers of each type of fusion essence; Selentine, Theryl, and so forth.

Purchase orders for Cypher artifacts must be made at the Shadow Salient requisition centre in Velmuna. The High Infuser keeps the especially valuable devices and items secreted away from the main collections for security reasons.

"Secreted", of course, is a term I borrow loosely. Quasi-hidden compartments in every chest that can only be unlocked via keys hidden around the building itself are not exactly the definition of security. Especially not, I suspect, after I have written about it here but, that is really not a problem of mine.
The building in question was, Behrem revealed, located just west of the Alfari capital of Shoal, or at least where it used to be.
After a brief search throughout the building, the Agonian did locate a fairly mystical looking key-like device behind a book marked, ironically enough, "Hiding in Plain Sight: the Do's and Don't"

quest_item.description_unlocked: A cunningly hidden arcane key that will reveal secret compartments in certain Alfari chests.
An ancient Alfari device used for the mystical translation of Nithron Runes.
